messages:
Maria (CS Manager): Heads up — onboarding batch for several new enterprise accounts experienced degraded embeddings & slow reads between 08:15–09:05 UTC this morning. Impacted routes: /embeddings/batch, /onboard/prefill. We have a partial mitigation but customers saw higher latencies and some 5xx. Incident ID INC-2026-0421.

incident-bot: [INC-2026-0421] Incident created — Embeddings service degradation. Severity: S2. Bridge: https://redwood.inc/bridges/INC-2026-0421

Devon (Solutions Eng): Can we get the list of affected customers? I saw three onboard batches timeouts in the logs (acct-phi, acct-orion, acct-lumen).

Jason (Engineering): Confirmed. Root cause: autoscaler misconfig for dedicated embedding workers + a race in the cache warmup. Push to prod fix deployed at 09:02 UTC. Post-fix metrics back to baseline by 09:20.

Eli (Onboarding Specialist): Which of those are in active onboarding (training + SSO) vs. evaluation? I need to update playbooks.

Maria (CS Manager): acct-phi & acct-orion are active onboarding; acct-lumen is in evaluation. Priority: acct-phi (20 seats, renewal Q3).

Priya (Account Exec): This will impact renewal health for acct-phi. Recommend proactive outreach + one-month credit. Also request a short technical RCA we can share.

Mateo (Support): I've started tickets for each account (T-1023/T-1024/T-1025) and attached logs. I'll escalate notes to priority.

Devon (Solutions Eng): Draft customer status update below, please review and shorten for email thread:

``` 
Hi <Customer>,

We experienced a temporary degradation of our embeddings service on 2026-04-21 between 08:15–09:05 UTC which affected some onboarding workflows (batch embeddings and prefill). We deployed a fix at 09:02 UTC. Actions taken: autoscaler configuration corrected, cache warmup sequence patched, and we are running extra validation.

Impact: higher latency and intermittent 5xx for embedding operations. Most requests retried successfully; a small subset saw failures requiring manual reruns.

Mitigation for you: our onboarding team re-ran failed batches and will confirm completion by EOD. We are crediting your account for the affected usage period.

Next steps: we will share a short technical RCA by EOD and schedule a 30-min sync if you'd like a walkthrough.

Apologies for the disruption — we're prioritizing stability during your onboarding.
```

Maria (CS Manager): Edits: replace "crediting your account" with "offering a one-month credit" and add sentence about follow-up survey link. Anyone object?

Priya (Account Exec): Works for me. Add "no action required from your side unless you see missing data" line.

Eli (Onboarding Specialist): I'll confirm reruns completed for acct-phi and acct-orion by 16:00 PT and post confirmation in tickets.

Jason (Engineering): RCA note for customer-friendly version: "misconfigured autoscaling threshold caused insufficient worker allocation during a spike; subsequent fix ensures aggressive warmup and a safety floor for workers." Keep it short.

Devon (Solutions Eng): Final draft below — please sign off, Maria.

```
Hi <Customer>,

We're reaching out about a temporary issue on 2026-04-21 (08:15–09:05 UTC) that affected embeddings during onboarding. We corrected the autoscaler configuration and deployed a patch to the cache warmup; normal service resumed by 09:20 UTC.

What we did for you:
- Re-ran failed onboarding batches for impacted teams (confirmed or in-progress).
- Applied a one-month service credit to your account.
- Added additional monitoring and an autoscaler safety floor.

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough of what happened and the remediation steps. No action is required from your side unless you notice missing data.

We apologize for the interruption and appreciate your patience.
Link to short feedback form: https://redwood.example/incident-feedback/INC-2026-0421

— The Redwood Onboarding Team
```

Maria (CS Manager): :thumbsup: Approve. Priya, please send to acct-phi and acct-orion now. Eli — confirm reruns and post ticket notes. Mateo — add credit notes to billing.

Priya (Account Exec): Sending now to acct-phi and acct-orion. I'll BCC CS and attach ticket links.

Mateo (Support): Billing credit applied for acct-phi and acct-orion. acct-lumen not billed yet — hold until they confirm evaluation.

Eli (Onboarding Specialist): Reruns started for acct-phi; I'll update at 15:30 PT. Also capturing customer feedback responses in the onboarding tracker.

Devon (Solutions Eng): For tracking renewal risk — tagging acct-phi as "at-risk" in CRM for 30 days and scheduling a success check-in next week.

Maria (CS Manager): Good. Let's also plan a short enablement webinar for next Tuesday focused on embedding reliability/monitoring for new customers — Devon/Eli, can you lead?

Devon (Solutions Eng): Yes. I'll prepare slides and sample runbook.

Maria (CS Manager): Thanks team. Closing thread when all tickets updated and customer replies acknowledged.
